facts.text: Multispectral Imager (MSI) was deployed at 433 Eros — Himeros Region during NEAR Shoemaker in 2001.
Seven-color framing CCD camera with refractive telephoto optics capable of resolving surface features down to millimeters during descent.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Returned the highest-resolution images ever taken of an asteroid, showing shattered rock fragments and smooth dust ponds.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at 433 Eros — Himeros Region.
Provided ground-truth optical characterization of an S-type near-Earth asteroid.
